title: Finite Q3 inverse-free sandwiched Schatten-Holder commutator envelope
question: Can a symmetric rho^(1/4)-sandwiched state norm bound a Q3 cutoff commutator by four-leg Schatten-4 factors without inverse Gibbs powers, and do finite rows provide a uniform local fourth-moment estimate?
method: For each declared volume, beta, and cutoff, build the finite actual-Q3 Hamiltonian, its normalized Gibbs density rho, and S=rho^(1/4) from the positive spectral root only.

For both cutoff orientations, all interpolation values, and both declared times, evolve the supported character with the finite perturbed Hamiltonian and set W to the cutoff tail and A to the evolved history.

Compute N2_sym(X)=||S X S||_2 and the four Schatten-4 legs L4_left(X)=||S X||_4 and L4_right(X)=||X S||_4. Check N2_sym([W,A]) <= L4_left(W)L4_right(A)+L4_left(A)L4_right(W), and repeat for the adjoint history.

Measure source and disjoint-tail commutators, summarize all 360 history rows and 30 support rows by volume and beta, reconstruct the entire lane independently, and compile Lean R346 for the scalar two-term assembly.
finding: Primary 821/821 and independent 819/819 pass. The integrated verifier passes 13/13 with Lean R346 PASS. The inverse-free Holder inequality holds for all 360 finite history rows and both adjoint orientations. The largest observed lhs/bound ratio is 0.041931489103944904. The largest finite envelope is 7.8499371712268875 and the largest lhs is 0.11986154052772928. At beta=0.125 the volume maxima are 2.9874168293939736 (V=2), 7.8499371712268875 (V=4), and 3.2084132299428685 (V=6); at beta=2 they are 1.5310283085027718, 2.4015850221048702, and 1.777401994922689. The largest tail fourth-leg factor is 3.9249685856134424. Measured source and disjoint-tail commutators remain below 7.82258885373977e-15 and 3.2040556572188632e-15 respectively.
decision_reason: The finite noncommutative factorization is a genuine inverse-free replacement for the prior Gibbs-similarity envelope: it keeps the state on the displayed side of every factor and uses the Schatten 1/4+1/4=1/2 Holder exponents. It therefore identifies a candidate direct-Duhamel integrand that does not require a finite Gibbs spectral floor. The finite envelope is loose and varies with beta and volume, and the tested finite maxima do not supply a local or common-core fourth-moment theorem. No asymptotic divergence or global no-go is inferred.

adversarial_review.check: The proof uses S[W,A]S=(SW)(AS)-(SA)(WS) exactly; no Gibbs factor is commuted through W or A.
Both products use Schatten 4 times Schatten 4 into Schatten 2, and the code computes singular-value norms rather than entrywise maxima.
Both W signs, every interpolation/time row, and the adjoint history are checked independently.
The new path constructs only the positive quarter root of rho; no inverse Gibbs power appears in the primary or independent code.
Source and disjoint-tail commutators are measured numerically in every finite row and are not inferred from graph labels.
Finite Gibbs positivity and spectral-root residuals are retained as diagnostics; no finite floor is interpreted as a thermodynamic lower bound.
The beta/volume/cutoff summaries show finite parameter dependence; neither their maxima nor the Holder residual closes a common-core uniform estimate.
Oscillator dimensions 3, 3, and 2 are explicit, so no exact infinite CCR or unbounded-domain statement is claimed.
The independent lane reconstructs the model and singular-value calculations without importing the primary program.
R346 certifies only nonnegative scalar two-term assembly and an exact rational fixture; matrix Holder and limits remain outside Lean.
Direct Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain false in the manifest and run artefacts.

qft_interface.closed: Finite inverse-free state-norm control of the cutoff commutator on the declared Q3 matrix fixtures, with independent and Lean cross-checks.
qft_interface.open: The local fourth-leg moments may depend on volume, source, cutoff and beta; an unbounded common-core estimate, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common carrier/dynamics, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 finite evidence only; no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner or physical-empty comparison is supplied.

next_action: Derive a local fourth-moment bound from the actual Q3 coercive energy form on a named common core, and prove its cutoff/source/volume/beta uniformity before inserting this Holder envelope into the direct Duhamel history recurrence. If that estimate fails, record the failure as route-local and keep the OS/KMS/GNS gates open.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite Q3 inverse-free Holder checkpoint. It is not a thermodynamic common-Hilbert theorem, a common-alpha construction, a mass-gap proof, a continuum result, or a QFT/Clay closure.
no_overclaim: This record promotes only the finite matrix Holder envelope and its declared diagnostics. It does not prove local moment uniformity, modular-domain transfer, direct Cauchy convergence, exhaustion independence, common alpha, Hamiltonian-OS identification, a GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
